description: Check whether this project or the catalog changed since the last check in a way worth interrupting for. Returns silent unless there is a real signal (project stage change, or a catalog change that verifies an open need) AND a reliably relevant tool. Deduped (same change is never notified twice) and rate-limited (at most one notification per project per 24h). Catalog changes are detected ONLY from the server-side catalog diff ledger (no ledger entry exists yet, so currently only project stage changes trigger); a client claim that the catalog changed is never accepted. The server has no scheduler and cannot push: this only answers when the host calls it. Whether the host can schedule is a server-side hint from the declared clientInfo.name (ChatGPT scheduled tasks and Cursor Automations count; other hosts do not) — a capability hint, not a verified host identity — never from a client claim; otherwise the answer is silent with reason host_no_scheduler and the host should check manually. The most this returns is a notification candidate (with a notif_id to acknowledge via notification_ack), never a confirmed delivery. Requires project_id and an Authorization: Bearer credential (owner key or project token); a key passed as a tool argument is never accepted.
name: check_project_changes
title: Check project changes
